page.notes: Marginal notes in the right margin: "Prophetiae Christi praecipue Evangelium fuit"; "Praeconium Regni Coelorum, fidei & resipiscentia"; partially faded and blurred in the scan. Some Greek and Hebrew words are approximate; the Hebrew and Greek readings near "השמועה", "רבנים ראשונים", "καὶ ἐξοχὴν" and "ἀσύνετοι" are uncertain. The marginal notes were set in small type and are partly illegible; the reading "Praeconium" and "Christi praecipue" is doubtful. Bleed-through from the reverse side appears faintly in the margins and is omitted.
